method: built-in image_gen; wholly new concept images; native unedited bytes; no partial repairs

toolArgs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE wholly new coherent cinematic PHOTOGRAPH-like concept frame for a historical running game in Beijing's Forbidden City around1914, SUMMER. Native upright3:4 portrait, high detail, restrained real-camera optics. Large authentic imperial palace architecture surrounds a SMALL HUMAN child; extraordinary material realism, never cartoon/caricature or a plastic3D render. Original faces, NO resemblance to actors or frame-for-frame recreation of any movie. Historically inspired fictional playful incident, not an archival photograph.

Recurring character: Puyi about8years old, a small Chinese BOY with believable child's proportions, youthful round face, dark eyes, long black braided queue down his back (a single thin long braid, not loose hair); small plain round Qing cap with a modest tiny finial. A luminous imperial BRIGHT YELLOW silk child-sized robe with restrained embroidered dragon motifs, long sleeves, cloth trousers and dark soft cloth shoes. No spectacles. Joyful determined playful energy, not a grim dangerous action hero, no exaggerated expression. Adults are warm humane dignified Qing household attendants: men in modest darkblue/gray long robes and round caps, women nurses in Manchu robes and appropriate headdresses. Concern and breathless gentle comedy come from the chase, not mockery, grotesque faces or humiliation. No injuries or violence.

Natural warm clear SUMMER sunlight, deep imperial vermilion-red walls, ocher/golden glazed Chinese tiled roofs, naturally weathered gray courtyard stone, fresh GREEN leafy trees in courtyards, NO autumn/yellow/fallen leaves and NO snow. Warm human storytelling and tactile REAL MATERIALS. Silk has realistic weave/folds and subtle directional sheen, not uniform engraved or stippled texture. Real pores and hands, believable anatomy and motion, honest optical softness where appropriate. Tiles with actual changing glazed reflections; stone and bronze/iron with localized irregular wear, never repeated texture stamps, global canvas grain or overprocessed sharpening. Preserve bright readable color without orange wash/HDR. NO vignette, decorative border, collage, watermark, captions, labels or UI.

All water vats are OPEN AND UNCOVERED, without blankets, quilts, fabric covers or winter wrapping. Absolutely no bicycle, car, train, aircraft, electric wires, antennas, modern lamps/architecture, tourists, cameras, backpacks, plastic or modern objects; no sunglasses, no eyeglasses for the child, no contemporary military uniforms. No Western fantasy costume or generic pan-Asian fantasy buildings. Grounded ForbiddenCity Qing architectural vocabulary: timber, redpaint, imperial yellow barrel tiles, painted blue/green eaves, real stone masonry. A SINGLE original child across each image, adults human and respectful. One fresh whole image, vertical3:4.

SCENE j1 — OVER THE THRESHOLD. A huge open vermilion palace gateway in a deep red wall, interior passage in cool shade, sunlit stone courtyard opening in foreground. Cinematic slightly low three-quarter camera on the COURTYARD SIDE looking back into the gate, so we see the small boy midair crossing the threshold TOWARD the sunlit court. Puyi is central and fully visible, visibly jumping ABOVE a very tall red/wooden rectangular threshold beam that spans the doorway floor: knee-height to an adult, UPPER-THIGH height to an8yearold. Both feet are lifted clear above the top beam edge, robe and sleeves billow and long braid flicks out behind him, original youthful face joyfully intent. No feet penetrating the beam, no ground-levelstep pretending to be a high threshold, no levitation without bent jumping knees.

The TWO heavy red timber door leaves are OPEN at either side, each inner face carrying orderly GOLD door studs in a clearly readable NINE ROWS BY NINE COLUMNS grid (81 per full leaf). The geometrically regular grids are discrete gold hemispherical domes, not 8rows, diagonal ornamental dots or random clusters; at least one WHOLE leaf's stud panel unobstructed and visible enough to count9x9. Door and wall dwarf the child, realistic timber thickness and hardware. Make the opening wide enough for the boy and adults rather than crushing them against one door.

Behind the boy in the shady corridor are THREE male palace household eunuch attendants and ONE female Manchu nurse, in humanly concerned respectful pursuit, no caricatures. One man starts to stumble at an EARLIER threshold behind this one, hands reacting naturally, another holds his round cap in place, nurse reaches forward. They remain behind the threshold the child is clearing. No pile-up, injury or broad slapstick face. Foreground courtyard in warm sunlight is paved with large irregularly worn gray stone slabs. Off to the foreground RIGHT, fully recognizable and not obscuring the boy or stud grid, is a LARGE low-footed round bronze FIRE-WATER VAT on a low stone plinth, with TWO opposite circular ring handles on animal-head mounts. It is a broad open storage vat, not a tall urn/cauldron on three tall legs or a modern bathtub. Dark aged bronze surface with restrained worn edges, natural shadows; potential hidingplace for the little child. Fresh GREEN summer trees in courtyard, red courtwalls and yellow tiled eaves beyond; NO autumn leaves, and water vat OPEN without fabric cover. One complete depth-rich photographic scene.

SCENE j2 — ON THE YELLOW ROOFS. A cinematic high three-quarter close-to-roof camera showing the same small yellow-robed8yearold Puyi running playfully along the broad upper RIDGE of a modest SIDE HALL, not the giant thronehall. One clothshoe planted credibly on the solid ridge, other stepping, long braid and silkrobe moving naturally; original youthful face in partial side profile, balanced body, no injury/falling. Gleaming but weathered GOLDEN YELLOW glazed tiles sweep downward across the foreground, rounded covertiles and channels with natural uneven specular highlights, blue-and-green painted timber eaves visible below. Boy remains small against the palace architecture, full body in view.

In front of Puyi toward the roof's outer end, on the descending corner HIP RIDGE where Chinese palace roofornaments belong, show ONE clearly readable row of SIX SMALL traditional ocheryellow ceramic roof figures, about30–40cm tall each, NOT child-sized giants and not live creatures. At the outer/leading tip, first is the little IMMORTAL RIDER SEATED ON A BIRD; then moving inward toward the highroof follow DRAGON, PHOENIX, LION, a traditional heavenly horse and a sea-horse-like traditional mythical animal. The leading rider is actually riding a bird, not standing alone or riding a horse. Distinct traditional silhouettes, restrained real ceramic glaze and realistic little mounting bases; no invented monsters, modern toys or men standing between figures. Keep count modest for a sidehall, never a procession of huge gargoyles and never more than10. Compose boy and figures close enough for their difference in height: boy~1.2m, figures only~0.35m.

Behind: a broad SEA OF authentic imperial yellow tiled roofs and vermilion courtwalls with no modern skyline. In the far background one grand hall shows its double-eaved layered yellow roof, distant secondary building, no close camera-anglecopy from movies. Far BELOW in courtyard, several small adult palace attendants in blue/gray Qing robes point up with human concern, one man CARRIES a period wooden LADDER on his shoulder; it is still DOWN BELOW, not improbably balanced beside the child on the ridge. Warm clear SUMMER sun, GREEN trees in courtyard, no autumn leaves, no snow and no blanket-covered water vats. Tangible real silk/ceramic/timber/stone, natural nonrepeating surfaces; scene comedy and grandeur, no caricatures.

SCENE j3 — QUIET VICTORY AT THE NORTHWEST CORNER TOWER. Year1914 Beijing, SUMMER, warm late-afternoon sunlight, green trees and hazy distant horizon. The same small8yearold yellow silk-robed Puyi is seen from behind/threequarters, standing safely on a BROAD STONE WALL-TOP WALKWAY beside the northwest corner tower. Both cloth shoes planted on the wide walking surface, relaxed upright body; NOT climbing, balancing on an outer ledge, standing on the parapet or falling. A credible solid brick/stone parapet separates walkway from the drop, low enough for him to look out without climbing. Long black braid down his yellow dragon-embroidered robe, small round Qing cap, no glasses. Full body reads in lower/middle foreground: quiet triumph and curiosity, small boy against vast old city.

On the LEFT, close ForbiddenCity NORTHWEST CORNER TOWER: authentic complicated intersecting multi-eaved Chinese yellow-glazed roofs with many elegant ridges/gables, vermilion timber walls and painted blue/green eavebrackets on the tall red/gray citywall. Not a generic freestanding Japanese pagoda or Buddhist tower. Large real timber/tile scale; upper roof can extend up leftframe. Child at the tower's base level on the roughly9m-high wallwalk. At its stair opening, behind and to one side, ONE adult male household attendant in darkblue/gray Qingrobe and cap catches his breath, a hand braced or holding cap, humane concern, no caricature. No active chase in this quiet final moment.

Below, a BROAD MOAT, roughly50m in scene scale, reflects warm light beside deepred outerwalls/graystone embankments and fresh GREEN summer trees. Beyond it, low gray1914HUTONG courtyard roofs and parkland, no modern streets or highrises. Far away include JINGSHAN hill with traditional pavilions along its crest and the separate distant WHITE BEIHAI DAGOba: a small white Tibetan-style stupa, bulbous base/tiered finial, NOT a white pagoda with projecting floors or the wrong Miaoying tower.

The simultaneous landmark layout is a deliberately COMPOSED CINEMATIC PANORAMA interpreting the briefing, not an exact geographic projection. Jingshan/pavilions toward RIGHT/eastern side; small separate Beihai white dagoba far LEFT/western side amid trees/lowroofs, broad oldcity between. Do not merge both landmarks into one hill or place the dagoba on Jingshan. One visually coherent photograph-like wide-angle vista, no panels or montage seams; exact simultaneous visibility from this nearboycamera is not surveyingtruth. Brief permits cinematic composition. No labels/arrows/explanatory text in image.

Natural optical depth and gentle atmospheric distance, nuanced warm light on silk/yellowceramics, irregular physical water shimmer, worn stone and old brick; no uniform engraved/stippled AI texture. GREEN summer vegetation, no autumn leaves, snow, modern buildings/objects, electric wires, tourists or blanket-covered water vats. Whole fresh upright3:4 cinematic photograph-like scene, no vignette.
